description: Compute the inter-aspect ledger between two agents' natal charts: pairwise planet-to-planet aspects (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition) with orb/exactness, plus tension / harmony / intensification scores and a recommended target stance (clash | absorb | mirror). Drives the desktop Jing Arena's counter-move pool selection. Pure math; pg cache used when seeded. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

natalChart.description: Natal chart with planets keyed by name, each having {sign, degree, retrograde?, house?}

cacheStrategy.description: read = use synastry_scores if present; write = compute and upsert; bypass = compute, skip pg. Default: read.

focusPlanets.description: Planets to include (default: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter)

name: compute_synastry_overlay
